lines.text: Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses over his Cushite wife and said the LORD also spoke through them.
The LORD told the three to come to the Tent of Meeting and came down in a pillar of cloud.
The LORD called Moses and Aaron forward and said He spoke with Moses face to face, clearly.
Miriam became leprous, and Aaron asked Moses to let the elders judge the matter.

wrong_details.wrong: To let the elders judge the matter
wrong_details.true: Not to hold their sin against them

lines.text: Miriam was confined outside the camp seven days, then the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in Paran.
